eval: (() => { const seg = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panels .card .seg button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Time range')); seg?.click(); return seg ? 'range' : 'no seg'; })()

(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panels button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Remove silences')); if (!b) return 'no button (no voiceover?)'; b.click(); return 'silence dialog'; })()
(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.modal button')].find(b => b.textContent.startsWith('Apply')); if (!b || b.disabled) return 'apply disabled'; b.click(); return 'applied'; })()

(() => { const k = document.querySelectorAll('.item.kw')[0]; if (!k) return 'no blocks'; k.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true })); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup')); return k.textContent; })()
(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.inspector'); s.scrollTop = 600; return document.querySelectorAll('.sel-box .h-scale').length + ' handles'; })()
